item.title: EplayerX 1.2.20
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 修复下载服务失效后任务停滞的问题，支持在应用内重试并重建下载连接，无需退出应用。 - 修复播放器剧集列表与当前播放服务器不一致的问题，改善季、集切换与选集播放。 - 改进自动跳过片头和下一集预加载，减少连播时从错误时间开始或使用不匹配片尾标记的情况。 - 优化媒体库元数据管理：在设置中直接查看、筛选和搜索媒体库，并改善离线媒体库浏览。 - 调整设置窗口尺寸与布局，改善媒体库管理面板的显示和操作。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Fixed downloads getting stuck after the system download service disconnects. Retrying now reconnects the download service without restarting the app. - Fixed player episode lists showing content from a different server, improving season switching and episode selection. - Improved automatic intro skipping and next-episode preloading to reduce incorrect start positions and mismatched outro markers during continuous playback. - Improved media library metadata management with browsing, filtering, and search directly from Settings, plus better offline library browsing. - Refined the Settings window size and layout for easier use of media library management panels.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
